mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS report_id, s.id AS session_id, s.title, s.started_at, s.ended_at, r.status, r.summary, r.avg_viewers, r.peak_viewers, r.total_chat, r.analyzed_chat, r.joy_count, r.excitement_count, r.support_count, r.surprise_count, r.sadness_count, r.anger_count, r.confusion_count, r.neutral_count, r.generated_at FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.streamer_id = #{streamerId}

WITH latest_by_platform_minute AS ( SELECT platform_session_id, date_trunc('minute', measured_at) AS measured_at, (array_agg(viewer_count ORDER BY measured_at DESC))[1] AS viewer_count FROM viewer_metrics WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} GROUP BY platform_session_id, date_trunc('minute', measured_at) ) SELECT measured_at, sum(viewer_count)::int AS viewer_count FROM latest_by_platform_minute GROUP BY measured_at ORDER BY measured_at ASC

SELECT id AS trigger_id, session_id, trigger_type, transcript_id, start_ms, end_ms, peak_z, peak_engagement, avg_viewers, chat_count, unique_chatters, analyzed_chat, joy_count, excitement_count, support_count, surprise_count, sadness_count, anger_count, confusion_count, neutral_count, narrative, screen_context, analysis_status FROM triggers WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY start_ms ASC, id ASC
SELECT id AS insight_id, report_id, title, content FROM report_insights WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id AS highlight_id, report_id, trigger_id, start_ms, end_ms, clip_url, thumbnail_url, clip_status FROM highlights WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY start_ms ASC, id ASC

SELECT rpm.platform_session_id, pa.platform AS platform_code, pa.channel_name, rpm.avg_viewers AS average_viewers, rpm.peak_viewers, rpm.total_chat, rpm.analyzed_chat, rpm.broadcast_seconds, rpm.viewer_coverage, rpm.data_quality FROM report_platform_metrics rpm JOIN broadcast_platform_sessions ps ON ps.id = rpm.platform_session_id JOIN platform_accounts pa ON pa.id = ps.platform_account_id WHERE rpm.report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY pa.platform, rpm.platform_session_id

SELECT vs.viewer_id, vp.nickname, vp.viewer_hash, vs.chat_score, vs.watch_score, vs.total_score FROM viewer_scores vs JOIN viewer_profiles vp ON vp.id = vs.viewer_id WHERE vs.session_id = #{sessionId} AND COALESCE(vp.user_role, '') NOT IN ('streamer', 'manager')
ORDER BY vs.total_score DESC, vs.viewer_id LIMIT #{limit}
